INSERT INTO pocketsound_tg_chats (tg_chat_id, chat_type, title, username)
VALUES (
  {{ $('Parse Incoming Audio').item.json.chat_id }},
  'private',
  '{{ $('Parse Incoming Audio').item.json.first_name }}',
  '{{ $('Parse Incoming Audio').item.json.username }}'
)
ON CONFLICT (tg_chat_id) DO NOTHING;

INSERT INTO pocketsound_files (
  owner_user_id,
  tg_chat_id,
  message_id,
  file_unique_id,
  title,
  artist,
  file_name,
  duration,
  file_size,
  mime_type,
  file_type,
  thumbnail_file_id,
  uploaded_at,
  created_at
)
VALUES (
  {{ $('Check user in DB').item.json.id }},
  {{ $('Parse Incoming Audio').item.json.chat_id }},
  {{ $('Parse Incoming Audio').item.json.message_id }},
  '{{ $('Parse Incoming Audio').item.json.audio.file_unique_id }}',
  '{{ $('Parse Incoming Audio').item.json.audio.title }}',
  '{{ $('Parse Incoming Audio').item.json.audio.performer }}',
  '{{ $('Parse Incoming Audio').item.json.audio.file_name }}',
  {{ $('Parse Incoming Audio').item.json.audio.duration }},
  {{ $('Parse Incoming Audio').item.json.audio.file_size }},
  '{{ $('Parse Incoming Audio').item.json.audio.mime_type }}',
  'audio',
  '{{ $('Parse Incoming Audio').item.json.audio.thumbnail_file_id }}',
  NOW(),
  NOW()
)
ON CONFLICT (file_unique_id) DO NOTHING;

SELECT id, title, artist, file_name
FROM pocketsound_files
WHERE file_unique_id = '{{ $('Parse Incoming Audio').item.json.audio.file_unique_id }}'
LIMIT 1;

INSERT INTO pocketsound_file_search_index (
  file_id,
  search_text,
  normalized_text
)
VALUES (
  {{ $json.id }},
  '{{ $json.title }} {{ $json.artist }} {{ $json.file_name }}',
  to_tsvector(
    'simple',
    LOWER('{{ $json.title }} {{ $json.artist }} {{ $json.file_name }}')
  )
)
ON CONFLICT (file_id) DO UPDATE
SET
  search_text = EXCLUDED.search_text,
  normalized_text = EXCLUDED.normalized_text;
